scope: Complete rendered choice lists within Encar mobile price-search manufacturer/model-group pages; not all Encar sale classifiers or all Korean-market manufacturer/model-year grades

policies.duplicatePopularChoices: Popular section appearances retained, never counted as additional manufacturers/model groups
policies.manufacturerCodes: Only codes in the actual linked manufacturer selection URLs; UI link IDs are not manufacturer codes
policies.modelGroupCodes: Not observed. A checked BMW model-group action returned the same maker URL/list, so browser-text reading did not execute the JavaScript selection state. No IDs invented.
policies.parentValidation: Each followed selector link recorded with its originating manufacturer choice, actual carType/mnfccd URL and returned model-group labels; known historical manufacturer codes cross-checked where available
policies.missingScope: Tesla is absent from this price-search manufacturer chooser but Tesla model names exist in the separate public model-name index. Absence here is not proof of absence from Encar sales taxonomy.
policies.cacheAndTime: checkedAt is the observation time; source crawled descriptions are search-tool cache observations, not a guarantee of a fresh origin response.
policies.rawFormat: These are browser-rendered textual fact observations with line numbers, not the original HTML response bytes; no hidden attributes or unexposed hierarchy codes are inferred.
